messages:
noah.sales: Procurement at Meridian Edge wants a POC evidence pack ASAP: SOC2 system description, ISO network diagram, signed pen-test acceptance, proof of periodic external vuln scans, and a short note on SSO/SAML support. They also want the Dedicated pricing broken out (reserved pool sizing) and confirmation who signs the pen-test letter (they asked for VP Security). Deadline: Friday COB.

ida.se: Quick clarifications: POC is Dedicated single-tenant per their message. For pricing we should know expected qps and token mix (embeddings vs. completion) because GPU sizing/throughput changes cost.

sam.security: We have a pen-test acceptance template. Legal usually signs; Security can append an attestation stamp. If they insist on VP Security signature we can route but expect +2 business days. Also: for external scans we require scope + scanner IP allowlist and an NDA addendum if raw reports are requested.

olivia.legal: I can sign the pen-test letter once Security approves scope. If Meridian wants our exec sig, please tell them Legal+Security stamp first and escalate exec sign only if mandatory. Any customer redlines = legal review time.

mike.ops: Ops notes: presigned upload is standard for datarooms. Example upload snippet:

infra-bot: presign example cached:

```bash
# upload evidence bundle
curl -X PUT "https://storage.redwood.example/evidence/meridian/poc-bundle.zip?X-Amz-Signature=..." -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --data-binary @poc-bundle.zip
```

ida.se: For Dedicated quote: if they expect sustained 100rps with avg prompt lengths, recommend 1 reserved pool (4 GPUs) baseline. Ballpark add-on +$13k/mo + one-time $3k provisioning. If they want autoscaling/burst add more.

noah.sales: They asked about SSO/SAML for the POC: can we provide SAML SSO for staging access?

sam.security: We support SAML for customer console access on Dedicated. For POC staging creds we provide ephemeral SSO-linked accounts; need their IdP metadata and ~48h to set up. That should be noted in delivery timeline.

ida.se: Also flag KMS: if they want customer-managed keys, add setup ~1 business day and a small setup fee.

olivia.legal: Action items: prepare pen-test template and note signer options (Legal sign + Security stamp vs exec sign).

mike.ops: I'll open a presign ticket and firewall ticket for any scanner IPs. ETA presigned link within 3 hours once we have the target path.

noah.sales: Callout blockers for Meridian meeting: 1) decision on pen-test signer (exec vs Legal), 2) token/qps numbers to finalize dedicated sizing, 3) confirmation of whether they need raw vuln reports or sanitized. If any slip they may delay.

infra-bot: ticket created (#OPS-12899). Ops will post presign link in #eng-infra and follow up on IP allowlist. :gear:
